review.summary: The rendered video introduces new titles that overlap with existing on-screen text and are not positioned optimally for readability against varying backgrounds. The original video's composition is altered by the new title placement.

findings.observation: The newly added title "Репка: проверяем читаемость титров" overlaps with the existing title "Репка" at the top left of the screen. This creates a cluttered and unreadable presentation.

The newly added title "Вместе легче справиться с задачей" is placed in the upper middle of the screen, which is not ideal for readability as it is against a light background with clouds, making the light-colored text less distinct.
The placement of the new title at the top left disrupts the original video's clean composition and obscures part of the existing title, which is a regression.

suggestions.reason: To ensure new titles do not overlap with existing on-screen elements and are placed in a more conventional and readable area, such as the bottom of the screen.
To provide adequate vertical spacing for the subtitles from the bottom edge, improving overall composition and readability.
To ensure the subtitles are appropriately sized for readability without being overly large or small, considering the target resolution.

limitations: Could not assess audio quality as both source and result videos were deliberately silent.
Could not verify the accuracy of the Russian text in the subtitles, only its placement and readability.
